intro.title: Welcome to Our Church
paragraphs: We are the Christian Seventh-day Adventist Church in Tacoma, Washington.
We are a multicultural community, part of the worldwide Adventist Church, who love Jesus and look forward to His Second Coming.
We also love people and enjoy being helpful to the community. We gladly serve God and others, trying to make the world around us kinder and better.
We warmly invite you to our services, which take place every Saturday at 10:00 AM at 9241 S D St Tacoma, WA.
